messages:
Meera Patel: Quick heads-up — while prepping a PR I hit a dead link in the Runtime Guide (batching). The kv-cache diagram image is 404. Ran into it via the local link-checker.
Jake O'Connor: ah good catch. which page + line?
Meera Patel: /runtime/batching.md around the 'KV cache' subsection (~line 120). link is to https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache-diagram.svg -> 404
Sam Lee: @Meera Patel can you paste the exact markdown snippet? I can rehost the asset if it's missing.
Meera Patel: snippet is: `![kv cache diagram](https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache-diagram.svg)`
Meera Patel: also found a small curl example below that still uses the old endpoint `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — should be `/v1/completions`. might be worth a tiny callout.
Nick Ramos: I'll take ownership of the diagram rehost + page patch. Will upload a fresh svg to /assets and open a PR. ETA today EOD. Assigning to me for now.
Jake O'Connor: thanks @Nick Ramos — can you also add a short note about the endpoint rename? or just update the snippet? Either works.
Nick Ramos: doing both. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (includes svg reupload, relative asset switch, and curl snippet update). @Sam Lee can you sanity-check the CDN path once I upload?
Sam Lee: looking. If you name it `kv-cache-diagram-v2.svg` we can create an alias so old absolute path 404s redirect to the new asset. I'll ping infra to add the tiny redirect rule.
docs-bot: link-scan: found 2 broken links on /runtime/batching.md; created DOCS ticket DOCS-789; noted PR 4123 when available.
Meera Patel: perfect — thanks everyone. If infra can't add the redirect, please prefer relative `/assets/runtime/kv-cache-diagram-v2.svg` in the markdown so moves don't break links later.
Nick Ramos: agreed. I'll switch to relative paths in the PR.
Jake O'Connor: lgtm, will queue review. :+1:
